delta_metrics.reason: Shadow-only candidate tagging; no trading policy changed.

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260418-004: C strategy was damaged by missing earnings fields and poor win rate.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260506-001: Fresh SEC/earnings audit found missing financial shock fields and no closed outcomes.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260507-002: Canonical replay coverage is complete; next action was candidate-row tagging.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260507-003: Recent SEC filing breakout sizing failed Gate 4; do not retry nearby filing-presence risk multipliers.
historical_experiment_check.playbook: SEC/earnings filing shock is high-priority only as auditable event confirmation or C grading, not raw SEC threshold sweeping.

hypothesis: Existing Ginger candidates tagged with PIT-safe SEC/earnings filing-shock context may reveal whether filing shock is useful as event confirmation or C-strategy grading, before any production rule is considered.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy profits but can lag indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

mechanism_insight_check.priority_change: exp-20260507-002 moved the blocker from replay coverage to candidate-row attribution.
mechanism_insight_check.why_not_repeat: This is not another risk multiplier or threshold replay. It persists and audits candidate tags only.

next_action: Do not promote a filing-presence sizing rule; exp-20260507-003 already failed. The next valid SEC/earnings step needs a richer event-quality discriminator with directional PIT fields or closed forward paper outcomes.
non_ohlcv_data_source: SEC filing features, SEC accepted metadata/text, existing earnings snapshots, canonical OHLCV snapshots for forward returns
